value: Diagnosis × PENK interactions to the error > correct contrast emerged in the right putamen, left rostral ACC extending into medial orbitofrontal cortex, and right IFG extending to the middle frontal gyrus.

These interactions were driven by robust group differences between CUD participants and controls in individuals with the higher-risk PENK C-allele: reduced error-related activations in CUD in the putamen and rACC/mOFC, and increased error-related activations in CUD in the IFG.
These group differences were either absent in individuals with the T/T genotype in the putamen and IFG, or reversed in the rACC/mOFC.
